title: Industrial Training Matcher — 6 Weeks & 6 Months Training in Lucknow | techcadd | techcadd Lucknow
metaDescription: Select your university (PTU, PU, Chitkara, CU, CU HP), engineering branch and semester to instantly match with approved 6 weeks or 6 months live industrial training tracks with project synopsis and report support.

hero.text: Set your university, branch and semester — see your matched live project track and duration instantly, with seat availability and syllabus one click away.

introCard.heading: 6 Weeks & 6 Months Training Matcher
introCard.text: Select your university, engineering branch and semester to instantly discover your approved live project track, verify seat availability, and download the official syllabus.

inputs.name: university
inputs.label: 1. Select your university / board
inputs.type: button-grid (single select, check icon on selected)

logic: Only the semester changes the result: year = min(4, ceil(semester/2)); show yearTracks[year] (tag, 'Semester {n} match', title, blurb, 'Session status' / 'Only {seats} Seats Left' — seats is a hard-coded number, not live). University and branch only change label text: 'Matched live project tracks for {branch}' and 'Curriculum verified for {university}.' The same 6 project tracks are always listed regardless of selection. 'Download Syllabus & Seats' and 'Request Free Callback' open a lead modal (no file download).

1.title: 2-Week Foundation Workshop
1.blurb: An early, low-pressure introduction to programming and tools. Most universities do not mandate training this early — this is optional groundwork.

2.title: 6 Weeks / 45 Days Summer Training
2.blurb: Meets your university's second-year industrial training requirement with a guided project and a verified certificate.

3.title: 6 Weeks / 2 Months Minor Project Training
3.blurb: Builds a production-grade live project to strengthen your resume before campus recruitment and fulfil university pre-final year training credits.

4.title: 6 Months Industrial Training with Internship
4.blurb: A full technology stack, a client-style live project and an internship letter — built for placement season.

projectTracks.title: MERN Stack Live Project
projectTracks.blurb: Full-stack application development from scratch with authentication, REST APIs, database architecture, and cloud deployment.

projectTracks.title: Python, AI & Machine Learning Track
projectTracks.blurb: Core Python algorithms, data analysis, and real-world predictive ML models with REST API building.

projectTracks.title: Java Full Stack Enterprise Development
projectTracks.blurb: Enterprise backend architecture using Spring Boot, Hibernate, microservices concepts, and SQL database optimization.

projectTracks.title: Cloud Computing & DevOps
projectTracks.blurb: Deploy and manage applications on AWS and Azure with Docker containers, CI/CD pipelines, and infrastructure automation.

projectTracks.title: Cybersecurity & Ethical Hacking
projectTracks.blurb: Penetration testing, vulnerability assessment, network security, and web application security on a live lab.

projectTracks.title: PHP / Laravel Full Stack
projectTracks.blurb: Server-side web development with PHP and Laravel, database design, REST APIs, and WordPress customisation.

compliance.heading: University Compliance & Project Deliverables
compliance.text: Every training track is structured to comply with PTU, GNDU, Uttar Pradeshi University, MRSPTU and PSBTE evaluation requirements.

items.title: College Synopsis & Approval Letter
items.body: Formal project synopsis drafted within the first two weeks for department guide sign-off and HOD approval.

items.title: Daily Training Diary & Logbook
items.body: Standardised documentation of daily learning modules, lab milestones, and weekly progress summaries.

items.title: Final University Project Report
items.body: Hard-copy and soft-copy report formatted to university guidelines with architecture diagrams, code, and references.

items.title: Live Deployment & Viva Prep
items.body: Live web application deployment or a certified CAD portfolio review, with mock viva sessions for external examiners.

compliance.collegesHeading: Students from these colleges regularly train with us

counsellorCard.heading: Need custom session timing or a college letter?
counsellorCard.text: Our academic counsellors guide you through PTU/GNDU training synopsis submission, session timings, and fast-track seat confirmation.

leadModal.subtitle: {course} (project title or 'General enquiry')
leadModal.privacy: We use your details only to contact you about this request.
leadModal.validation: name non-empty and phone /^[0-9+\s-]{10,15}$/ else 'Please enter your name and a valid phone number.'
leadModal.post: POST /api/enquiry {name, phone, course, message:'Training Matcher: {title}', source:'Training Matcher tool'}

success.heading: Request received
success.text: A counsellor will call you within one working day with seat availability and the syllabus for {course}.

data.footerLine: Choosing a track for the first time? Take the Career Track quiz to find your field before matching a session. (/tools/career-track)

cards.title: Industrial training
cards.text: 45 days, 6 weeks, 6 months and 9 months, aligned to university requirements and closed with an internship letter.

cards.title: Find my career track

cards.title: College partnerships
cards.text: Workshops, mandated industrial training, faculty development and joint placement drives, run on your department's timetable.
